e.summary: 神经网络在车险费率厘定上是否随规模提升？真实车险组合上的缩放律实证（2026-09-02 预印本）
e.summary_en: Do neural networks improve with scale in motor ratemaking? Scaling-law evidence on a real motor portfolio (preprint, 2026-09-02)
e.summary_hk: 神經網絡在車險費率釐定上是否隨規模提升？真實車險組合上的縮放律實證（2026-09-02 預印本）
e.body: 《Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models》（arXiv 2609.03106，2026-09-02）研究一个精算生最常问的问题：深度学习里的**缩放律（scaling law）**——留出损失随模型容量、数据量与算力增加而按幂律改善——在**表格型、异质、含噪**的精算费率厘定数据上是否同样成立？作者在一个**真实车险组合**上训练多个模型，与仍属强基线的经典 GLM 对比。对 RIAA：这是「神经网络到底能不能打败 GLM」这一争论的近期实证证据，价值在于它把问题从「谁更强」改写为「**在什么数据规模与容量下**谁更强」；阅读时可与 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[glm]]（经典基线）、[[tabpfn-insurance]]（表格基础模型用于保险）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价路线）、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 对照，并与 [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]]（巨灾风险的缩放律研究）形成「定价端 vs 巨灾端」的缩放律对照；[[ins-actbench]] 则从 LLM 能力评测角度覆盖精算任务。注意：预印本，**未发现配套代码仓库**，结论以文中数字为准。
e.body_en: "Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models" (arXiv 2609.03106, 2026-09-02) investigates a question actuarial students ask constantly: do the **scaling laws** of deep learning — held-out loss improving as a power law with model capacity, data and compute — also hold on the **tabular, heterogeneous and noisy** data of actuarial ratemaking? The authors train multiple models on a **real-world motor insurance portfolio** and compare against classical GLMs, which remain strong baselines. For RIAA: recent empirical evidence in the "can neural nets beat GLMs" debate, valuable because it reframes the question from "which is stronger" to "**at what data scale and capacity** is each stronger"; read it against [[insurance-glm-tools]] and [[glm]] (classical baselines), [[tabpfn-insurance]] (tabular foundation models for insurance), [[machine-learning-pricing]] (the ML pricing route) and [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]], and set it against [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]] (scaling laws in catastrophe risk) as a "pricing side vs catastrophe side" contrast; [[ins-actbench]] covers actuarial tasks from the LLM-capability angle. Note: preprint, with **no accompanying code repository found** — treat the conclusions as those reported in the paper.
e.body_hk: 《Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models》（arXiv 2609.03106，2026-09-02）研究一個精算生最常問的問題：深度學習裡的**縮放律（scaling law）**——留出損失隨模型容量、數據量與算力增加而按冪律改善——在**表格型、異質、含噪**的精算費率釐定數據上是否同樣成立？作者在一個**真實車險組合**上訓練多個模型，與仍屬強基線的經典 GLM 對比。對 RIAA：這是「神經網絡到底能不能打敗 GLM」這一爭論的近期實證證據，價值在於它把問題從「誰更強」改寫為「**在什麼數據規模與容量下**誰更強」；閱讀時可與 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[glm]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 對照，並與 [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]]（巨災風險的縮放律研究）形成「定價端 vs 巨災端」的對照；[[ins-actbench]] 則從 LLM 能力評測角度覆蓋精算任務。注意：預印本，**未發現配套代碼倉庫**。
e.verified_note: arXiv 元数据核实（2609.03106v1，2026-09-02 提交，真实车险组合上的缩放律实证）；arXiv 页面未见配套代码仓库，未复现
